name: ibis
description: Cite from your own reference library: search Zotero, BibTeX or CSL-JSON and format citations from real records, read-only and offline.

interface.longDescription: Search your Zotero, BibTeX or CSL-JSON reference library and format citations from real records. Ibis reads the library chosen in the Ibis app, stays read-only and works offline. Requires the ibis command on PATH with support for --app-libraries and a connected Ibis MCP server.
